run_bucc_optimize_threshold: run the BUCC bitext mining tool with --gold to find the optimal alignment threshold
run_bucc_extract_bitexts: run the BUCC bitext mining tool with --threshold to extract aligned sentence pairs above a score
run_bucc_cli: run the BUCC bitext mining CLI with --src-lang, --trg-lang, --bucc-texts, --bucc-ids, and --candidates
summarize_BuccOptimize: summarize the BuccOptimize function that finds the optimal threshold by maximizing F1 score over gold alignments
summarize_BuccExtract: summarize the BuccExtract function that filters candidate pairs by score threshold and writes bitexts to a file
